```yaml
id: vuln-anything-llm-94ed62d3
languages: [javascript]
message: "Potential command injection vulnerability in ripgrep search function"
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cwe: [CWE-77, CWE-88]
  description: |
    The ripgrep search function is vulnerable to command injection attacks.
    The pattern argument is not properly sanitized before being passed to ripgrep.
    An attacker could craft a pattern like "--pre=/bin/sh" to execute arbitrary commands.
  author: "security-team"
  created_at: "2023-10-15"
  updated_at: "2023-10-15"
  references:
    - https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/1234
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-48116

pattern: |
  spawnSync(
    rgPath,
    [
      # ... other arguments
      pattern,
      searchPath,
      # ... other arguments
    ],
    # ... other options
  )
```
